name: Tiger Tops Karnali Lodge
summary: A small, high-end safari lodge on the edge of Bardia National Park near Thakurdwara, built in local Tharu style and run by Tiger Tops, one of Nepal's oldest wildlife lodge operators. Full-board stays include naturalist-led walks, drives and river trips.
body: Tiger Tops Karnali Lodge sits in the buffer zone on the western side of Bardia, among farmland and forest, a short drive from the park gate at Thakurdwara. The lodge is built with local materials in the style of Tharu village houses, with cottages arranged around gardens and a central dining and bar area. It is mostly solar powered and keeps the scale deliberately small, so the atmosphere is quiet and personal rather than resort-like.

Stays are usually sold as full-board packages with activities led by the lodge's own naturalists: jungle walks in search of tigers, full-day jeep drives on the Karnali side, river floats for dolphins and crocodiles, and Tharu village visits. Tiger Tops is known for its elephant programme, which has moved away from riding towards observing and caring for elephants. The company supports community projects in nearby villages, including farming and handicraft programmes. Ask us about seasonal closure dates and any river or camp options running in your travel month.
why: The most polished safari stay in western Nepal, with its own experienced naturalists
Small and quiet, built in Tharu style with solar power and local materials
Ethical elephant programme focused on observation rather than riding

faqs.q: Is Tiger Tops Karnali Lodge worth the price?
faqs.a: For travellers who want the best guiding and comfort in Bardia, yes. Rates are much higher than family-run lodges in Thakurdwara, but they include full board, naturalist-led activities and a calm, well-run setting. If your budget is tight, a mid-range lodge with a strong independent guide gives similar tiger chances for far less.

faqs.q: Can you ride elephants at Tiger Tops Karnali?
faqs.a: Tiger Tops has moved away from elephant riding. Its elephant programme focuses on walking with, observing and learning about the lodge's elephants, which live in more natural conditions. Wildlife viewing itself is done on foot, by jeep and by raft. Ask us for the current details of the elephant experience.

faqs.q: When is Tiger Tops Karnali Lodge open?
faqs.a: Like most Bardia lodges, it operates mainly from autumn to late spring, roughly October to early June, and closes or reduces service during the monsoon, when the park floods and safaris largely stop. Exact dates vary by year, so we confirm opening dates when you enquire.

name: Mango Tree Lodge
summary: A family-run lodge in Thakurdwara, close to the Bardia National Park gate, known for experienced local wildlife guides and a relaxed garden setting. A good mid-range base for walking safaris and full-day jeep drives.
body: Mango Tree Lodge is set in a garden in Thakurdwara village, a short walk from the headquarters of Bardia National Park. It is owned and run by a local family whose background is in wildlife guiding, and that shows in the way the lodge plans safaris: early starts, long days in the park and guides who know the tiger territories along the Karnali and its streams. Cottages are simple and comfortable, and meals are served in a shared dining area.

The lodge suits travellers who want to spend most of their time in the park rather than at a resort. Guests often stay three or four nights, mixing jungle walks with full-day jeep safaris and a river float. In the evening there is time to compare sightings with other guests over dinner. Bicycles and Tharu village walks fill the hot middle of the day. We use Mango Tree for many of our standard Bardia packages and confirm room types and current rates for each booking.
why: Family-run by people with a long background in Bardia wildlife guiding
A few minutes' walk from the park headquarters and gate
Good value for three- to five-night tiger-focused stays

faqs.q: How far is Mango Tree Lodge from the Bardia park gate?
faqs.a: It is in Thakurdwara village, a short walk from the park headquarters where walks and drives begin. That saves time on early mornings and makes it easy to visit the crocodile breeding centre and park office. Jeeps pick guests up directly at the lodge for full-day safaris.

faqs.q: Is Mango Tree Lodge good for families?
faqs.a: Yes. The garden setting, simple cottages and relaxed atmosphere suit families, and the guides adapt activities for children, such as shorter walks, river floats and village visits. For long jungle walks we recommend children be at least 12. Air-conditioning or cooling options matter from April, so confirm room type when booking.

faqs.q: What activities can I book at Mango Tree Lodge?
faqs.a: Guided jungle walks, half-day and full-day jeep safaris, Karnali river floats, bicycle rides and Tharu village visits. Park fees, jeep hire and guide charges are usually priced separately or bundled into our packages. Full-day safaris with packed lunch give the best tiger chances.

name: Siddhartha Hotel Nepalgunj
summary: An upscale hotel in Nepalgunj near Mahendra Stadium, widely used by Kailash yatra groups, Bardia safari travellers and business visitors. Air-conditioned rooms, a pool, restaurants and an airport shuttle make early mountain flights easier.
body: Siddhartha Hotel is one of the largest and best-known hotels in Nepalgunj, spread over several floors in the city near Mahendra Stadium and Nepalgunj College. It is a short drive from the airport, which matters when your Simikot, Jumla or Talcha flight leaves at 6 am. Rooms are air-conditioned, an essential in a town where May temperatures pass 40 °C, and the hotel has an outdoor pool, restaurant, bar and meeting rooms.

Kailash Mansarovar groups use the hotel heavily between May and September, so staff are used to large groups, early breakfasts, luggage storage while guests are in Tibet, and last-minute changes when mountain flights are delayed. It also works well as a comfortable first night for travellers arriving overland from Lucknow, and as a base before or after a Bardia safari. We book it for most of our Nepalgunj overnights and confirm room categories and airport transfers for each group.
why: Short drive to Nepalgunj airport for dawn flights to Simikot, Jumla and Talcha
Air-conditioning and a pool for the fierce Terai heat
Experienced with Kailash groups, early departures and luggage storage

faqs.q: Is Siddhartha Hotel Nepalgunj close to the airport?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a short drive from Nepalgunj airport, typically 10–15 minutes in light traffic. The hotel offers airport transfers, which are useful for early mountain flights to Simikot, Jumla and Talcha. We include transfers in our packages and time pick-ups around current flight schedules.

faqs.q: Can I leave luggage at the hotel during a Kailash trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Kailash groups commonly store extra luggage at their Nepalgunj hotel while flying to Simikot with a 15 kg limit. Siddhartha Hotel handles this routinely. Label bags clearly, keep valuables with you, and confirm storage arrangements with your group leader before departure.

faqs.q: Does Siddhartha Hotel Nepalgunj have a swimming pool?
faqs.a: Yes, the hotel has an outdoor pool, which is very welcome from April to September when Nepalgunj is extremely hot. It also has a restaurant, bar and meeting rooms. Pool opening times and any seasonal maintenance closures can change, so ask at check-in.
